name: bollinger_ema_sar_v4_robustness
candidate: V4: V3 causal entry logic + stop active + profit exit at close of third consecutive candle in trade direction
core_rules_frozen: rocket rejection wick >=70% of body OR body engulfing
higher low LONG / lower high SHORT signal shape
EMA3 crosses EMA9 on fully closed signal candle
EMA3 and EMA9 both slope in trade direction on signal bar
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal candle
EMA9/20 future crossing is diagnostic only and cannot be used retroactively

temporal: fixed first half vs second half

selection_policy: Robustness is a rejection test, not a parameter search. Do not choose 2, 3, or 4 candles because it has the highest discovery return. Baseline remains 3; neighbors only test whether the edge collapses.
next_stage_if_pass: Freeze V4 baseline unchanged and run once on untouched 2022-09-01 through 2025-09-24 confirmatory data. Do not unseal final holdout.
if_fail: Do not retune on confirmatory or holdout data. Diagnose failure inside discovery only.
